vb_textbox.text: Choose one of the gnomes at random to start. If you get less than 5 mushrooms, pick the gnome of the same height again in the next round and see if you get less than 5 mushrooms again... If you received less than 5 both times then choose the gnome of the different height in the next round.If a gnome gives you 5 or more mushrooms then keep choosing the same height of gnome in the next round.Repeat the first step if a gnome gives you 1/2/3/4 mushrooms until you keep getting higher than 5.The colour of the gnomes did not seem to have a consistent pattern relating to the number of mushrooms given.
